title: How Finishing First Changes a Godly Man's Work
caption:
The new thing always looks holier than the one you're already in.

New workout plan. New reading plan. New job, new season, new everything. They all look cleaner than the project three weeks deep that's finally gotten boring.

That's not discernment. That's boredom wearing a costume. Set one rule: finish what's in front of you, or name it dead on purpose and let it go. Nobody trusts the guy with twelve unfinished things. God isn't impressed by how many things you started either.
